source_of_truth: Read by hand: OrderList awaits useFetch and renders a skeleton while pending, then a v-for over rows; no empty, error or partial branch exists in the file. OrderTable switches on a status union covering loading, empty, error, partial and success. The missing states in OrderList may be handled by a parent, so the honest level is heuristic.

expected.rationale: renders fetched rows; only loading and success are visible in the file
